root_idea.summary: A root orientation toward restless movement, coming and going, and turning from one position to another.
root_idea.development: This motion-oriented sense develops into withdrawal, retreat, and fleeing; مَنَاصٌ can denote either the escape sought or a refuge and recourse, while related forms describe restless movement and head-raising.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized noun citation form مَنَاصٌ rather than the inflected Quranic surface form مَنَاصٍ.

senses.definition: Escape, withdrawal, or a way of getting away.
senses.usage_conditions: In وَلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ, it denotes the opportunity or possibility of fleeing or retreating that is no longer available.

senses.definition: A refuge, safe recourse, or means of seeking protection.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction وَلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ, the word is also interpreted as referring to recourse, petitioning, or seeking aid and protection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set oneself in motion, go away, or possess the movement and activity needed to act.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes preparing oneself for movement and, in an expression about a person, having strength or activity for accomplishing a task.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to raise its head and set itself in motion to run.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially said of a horse whose bridle is being drawn in while it is urged into motion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise or come up to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with إِلَى to describe movement toward a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn aside from or avoid an affair, or to withdraw from and flee an opponent, eluding him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the broader verbal use of turning away, withdrawing, or fleeing outside the specific Quranic noun construction.
The designation is associated with its restless raising of the head and going to and fro as though fleeing at random.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who raises the head and runs away at random; specifically, a wild ass, and also a horse that raises its head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial description of restless head-raising and erratic movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To work at or handle a jar.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct Form III usage recorded for ممارَسة الجَرَّة, ‘working at the jar.’
